stable issuer, listed parent, privacy-safe title, season, episode, edition, article, program, channel, feed, platform, territory, language, rights package, release window, distribution outlet, takedown, correction and settlement identities without current-catalog projection

The absent complete lawful point-in-time privacy-safe content-rights-distribution lifecycle source is the binding gate.
